headline: Executive order creates a council to advise the President on engaging with people of African descent living in the United States.
what_it_does: This order sets up a new group called the President's Advisory Council on African Diaspora Engagement in the United States. Based on the title, the council's job is to give the President advice related to the African diaspora, meaning people of African descent living in the U.S. No summary was provided, so details such as who serves on the council and what topics it covers are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: People of African descent living in the United States
who_it_affects.how: The council is set up to advise the President on how the federal government engages with this community.
They would serve on the new advisory body and give advice to the President.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 13, 2022; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
